title: Seasonality
description: Speed and delay patterns across the four seasons, compared against the current year's average.
_note: Reconstructed via --from-page 2210658. Dates already correctly live from the earlier working round (calendar: formulas, including Winter's year-wrap). Two real fixes found: (1) the 4 'Speed in <season> Compared to Year Average' difference graphs were CURRENTLY BROKEN — their year-average anchor referenced a dead comp (comp-10, distinct from the live 'Current Year' comp-9), leaving each with only 1 real arm; re-pointed the anchor at the live Current Year route, restoring the comparison. (2) 3 of 4 'Avg. Hours of Delay by Weekday' per-season graphs referenced dead season-specific 'Weekday' sub-routes (comp-17/19/20 — only Winter's, comp-18, survives); rather than drop that capability, added ONE consolidated graph overlaying all 4 seasons' weekday breakdown using the live Avg Day routes directly (weekday filtering is graph-level now, no dead sub-routes needed) — kept the original Winter-only graph too since it already works, some overlap is harmless. Dropped 1 graph ('Avg. Hours of Delay by Season', mismatched Current-Year+Winter-Weekday routes even before considering the measure) — needs the avgHoursOfDelay+summary combo, still guarded/unbuilt — THIRD real template needing it now (after Single Route and This Month vs. Last Month vs. Last Year), worth building for real once the sweep is done.
